 This Ccc Coming On For Orders, This Day,
K.Somashekar J., Made The Following:
 -3-
 Ccc No. 100280 of 2022
 Order
Learned counsel Sri.Hanumanthareddy Sahukar for the complainant and the learned AAG representing the learned HCGP for the accused are present before the Court physically.

2. Learned AAG has filed an affidavit dated 09.12.2022 of one M.Sundaresh, Deputy Commissioner,
Koppal.

In para 5 of the affidavit, it is stated that the Commissioner passed an order on 14.10.2010,
as per the directions of this Court in WP No.48466/2004 and wherein the order was challenged by the complainant in WP No.65363/2011 and the same was quashed.

Further in para 8 of the affidavit,
it is made clear that the Managing Director, Rajiv Gandhi Rural Housing Corporation Limited,
Bengaluru has returned the proposal on 19.05.2022 stating that about 50 years back, the houses and huts were constructed in the said land and the owner is not in possession of the said land since 50 years and as such, the question of acquisition of the said land and to pay the compensation to the owner does not arise.

entities.text:
Rajiv Gandhi Rural Housing Corporation Limited,
Bengaluru
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Supporting to the said para 8, document No.3 has been produced.

In para 12,
it is stated that he has highest regards and respect for the order of this Hon'ble Court or orders passed by any Court of law and not disobeyed the directions/orders of this Court willfully or intentionally and therefore, seeking to accept the affidavit filed and drop the contempt proceedings.

3. However, the learned counsel for the complainant submitted that considering the document No.4,
the letter addressed to the Member Secretary, Housing Department, Vikasa Soudha, Bengaluru,
liberty may be granted in accordance with law.
4. The submission made by the learned counsel is placed on record.
However, keeping in view the affidavit alongwith the documents filed by the learned counsel for the accused, we deem it appropriate to drop the proceedings.
Accordingly, the contempt proceedings is hereby closed.
